description: Pinned external posse case t1222 head 30c14997.
intent:
feat(review): add the Greenhouse host-mode adapter behind a hidden command (Phase 1 G-2)

Done when: A Greenhouse adapter implements the review provider interface from G-1 using Greenhouse host mode (attach, apply, review with a per-round grant, watch, host_result), reachable only through a hidden command, as specified in docs/research/2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md sections 2.2-2.4 and 2.8 (step G-2).; Posse starts the Greenhouse daemon itself, outside every Task cgroup and without Task markers, with GREENHOUSE_HOME=<POSSE_HOME>/greenhouse (mode 0700); a Worker never calls Greenhouse; `posse doctor` reports the daemon protocol range.; Every case of the G0 fault table in section 2.6 is an automated test against the real `greenhouse` binary with a fake reviewer, an isolated POSSE_HOME and an isolated Herdr server, and runs in CI; the adapter survives a daemon restart and a protocol refusal.; No change to existing review, publish or merge behaviour.

expected.defect: axi converts every response with outcome "error" into a generic error before returning the decoded response. Protocol negotiation refusals therefore never reach response.refusal or Daemon.probe, so a daemon that reports an incompatible protocol range cannot produce ProtocolError or the required persisted range; Ensure instead reports a generic AXI error and the protocol-refusal contract fails.
